abuse: Writing that invites pain, rough use, or violence.
bondage: Writing about being bound, gagged, or kept restrained.
crime: Marks naming the wearer a criminal or stating a sentence.
rape: Writing declaring that the wearer may be taken by force.
slave: Marks of ownership, obedience, or servitude.
symbol: Small pictures without text, such as hearts.
toilet: Writing that offers the wearer as a urinal.
